hints.sentence: A store charge reaches the app's billing records only when the subscriber next opens the app, so the stores' excess over the records belongs to subscriptions last seen still set to renew, not to every account in proportion.

The attribution export holds an iOS network's installs only where the user allowed tracking, and those users are worth more than the rest even at the same first two days; the rest sit among the accounts with no channel.

A week's spend is what the platform chose to deliver of the week's budget given that week's auction, so weeks of high and low spend are not weeks of high and low budgets; what a budget buys shows in the weeks the team moved it.
